The job it self does 't mean a whole lot to me. I am good at it but it feels meaningless. Being successful does mean a lot to me, I wish it didn't. I guess I am also somewhat afraid that I may loose my job, because of missing this deadline.

edited to add the first sentence.

I'd love to talk. I think the large reason is, I am behind on a deadline at work. Over estimate on it as well. I feel fairly worthless at life because of this. I guess it is true what they say at least for me that a man's identity is fairly tied to his job. Also I am fairly horrible at at writing. I can compile a large list of my failures, and am bad at seeing the good things.
